description: Say when a city's clocks next change, and whether a planned local time falls in the spring gap or the autumn overlap. from and to bound the search, YYYY-MM-DD. Pass both or neither. When omitted, the window is today (UTC) through 365 days later. The next change is the first offset change in that window, the same list get_dst_changes uses. weeks is iso_week and us_week of that next change, or null when the window has none. The change object and a planned time do not repeat the week numbers. planned_time is a local wall time, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, in that city. status is unique when that clock time happens once, gap when the clocks skip it (spring forward, including the southern hemisphere), or overlap when it happens twice (clocks go back). shifted is true for a gap or an overlap. utc is the compatible resolution: the later side of a gap and the earlier side of an overlap. Do not treat utc as the only reading when shifted is true.

city.description: City name or a city id from search_cities. Spelling and accents are flexible. When several cities share a name, the best match from the site search is used and the others come back in alternatives.

from.description: First day of the search, YYYY-MM-DD. Pass with to, or omit both.

planned_time.description: Local wall time in the city, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

to.description: Last day of the search, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: dst_check

alternatives.description: Other cities that matched the same name, after the best-ranked city was chosen. The order is the site search order: match, then priority, then population.

weeks.description: ISO week (Monday start; week 1 contains the year's first Thursday) and US week (Sunday start; 1 January is week 1 of that calendar year).

title: Next clock change and a planned time
